motion.$description: Timing shared by every product. Controls (press, hover, toggles, tabs) always use the duration and easing steps, so they feel the same on every page. Arrivals and celebrations use a mood: calm or energetic. Each theme picks its default mood, any page can switch with data-motion, and reduced motion always gets calm with no movement. Durations and easings come from the Life Hub Figma Glass, Motion, Sizing page.

instant.$description: Press: a slight shrink, no color change.

fast.$description: Hover and small state changes: color, a 1px lift, a switch thumb.

base.$description: Something moving into place: a tab indicator, a card's shadow, a panel settling.

slow.$description: Fading in, and a progress bar filling.

out.$description: Entering and hover. Fast start, soft landing.

in-out.$description: Reversible changes that go both ways, like a toggle or a tab.

stagger.$description: Step between items in a list as they arrive one after another.

calm.$description: Things arrive quietly: they settle into place and never bounce.

arrive-distance.$description: How far something travels as it arrives.

celebrate-scale.$description: How big a win grows at its peak before settling.

energetic.$description: Anime energy for earned moments: things snap in, overshoot and settle. Save it for arrivals and wins, never for controls.

arrive-easing.$description: Overshoots its target a little, then settles back.
